Unbelievably excellent
Oct 2022 • Solo
Fancied some little assorted plates tonight and this place was near my hotel. Ordered some maki rolls - excellent, some skewers, chicken liver, chicken thigh with leek and chicken butts, also eggplant, Japanese potato salad was so good and of course pickles. Had a cheeky highball Japanese whiskey, then I was given a glass of sublime sake complimentary. Service is exactly you would find in Tokyo, food dead authentic, will probably come back tomorrow and the next day it was that good.

Great dinner with atmosphere!
Jun 2019 • Solo
A robatayaki/izakaya place with atmosphere...! I have been here several times and never felt alone even if I were eating by myself ... Great place with authentic Japanese flavour. The District 1 location was conveniently located to the hotel I was staying (Le Meridien Saigon). Recommended if u enjoy a good sake or beer on your own... and btw, part of the fun is locating this restaurant within the maze of alleys in Japanese street... and Google map won't help much...😁😁
